description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage industrial automation startup as its first engineer, building a perception system that understands manual work in factories. You will take computer vision from experimentation through production deployment, starting with real-time quality inspection and helping shape the technical foundations for future robotic automation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build perception systems for detection, classification, tracking, temporal understanding, and 3D vision.

 - Develop first-person vision that handles camera motion, changing viewpoints, occlusion, motion blur, and variable lighting.

 - Work with the technical leadership team to improve models, datasets, and evaluation based on failures in real deployments.

 - Build geometric vision capabilities for calibration, localization, pose estimation, and coordinate transformations.

 - Train and debug PyTorch models using synthetic and real-world data.

 - Optimize low-latency inference and deploy systems on NVIDIA Jetson using TensorRT.

 - Work directly on factory floors and turn deployment learnings into reusable perception infrastructure.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience building and deploying computer vision, robotics perception, or applied machine learning systems outside notebooks or lab environments.

 - Experience shipping real-time perception systems in computer vision, robotics, industrial robotics, AR/VR, ADAS, or physical AI.

 - Strong Python, PyTorch, and OpenCV skills, including experience developing detection, classification, or tracking models.

 - Experience with geometric vision and ownership of an underspecified physical-world problem from development through deployment.

 - Experience with edge deployment or production inference optimization, and working with users or in field deployments.

 - Experience with synthetic data and Sim2Real, SLAM or VIO, depth estimation, 3D reconstruction, CUDA, TensorRT, ROS2, robot manipulation, or robot learning is beneficial.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $120,000 to $200,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. The role includes an opportunity to help shape the engineering team and technical direction.


LOCATION

On-site in the United States.
